extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-txt.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 Text File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-txt.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF document and write it to a UTF‑8 encoded .txt file.

extract-pdf-text-in-memory.title: Extract PDF Text In-Memory Using PdfExtractor
extract-pdf-text-in-memory.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF in memory, load it from a MemoryStream, extract its text with PdfExtractor, and write the result to another MemoryStream for further processing.

check-pdf-contains-text.title: Check if PDF Contains Text Using PdfExtractor
check-pdf-contains-text.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF into a MemoryStream with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and determine if the document contains any text by inspecting the stream length.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs with PdfExtractor
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through a directory, use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from each PDF, and write the results to UTF-8 text files.

check-pdf-for-text-and-images.title: Check PDF for Text and Images using PdfExtractor
check-pdf-for-text-and-images.description: Shows how to verify that a PDF contains both textual content and images by leveraging Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Text and Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF file to a PdfExtractor and simultaneously extract its textual content and embedded images page by page.

extract-text-from-protected-pdf.title: Extract Text from Password-Protected PDF
extract-text-from-protected-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF with an owner password using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, extract its text, and write the result to a file.

extract-pdf-text-utf8.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save as UTF‑8 File
extract-pdf-text-utf8.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF document and write it to a UTF‑8 encoded text file, ensuring proper handling of international characters.

extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.title: Extract Text from PDF Using PdfExtractor and MemoryStream
extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array into a MemoryStream and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract the document's text without any file system I/O.

extract-pdf-text-per-page.title: Extract PDF Text and Save Each Page to a File
extract-pdf-text-per-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF, split it into individual pages using the form‑feed delimiter, and write each page's text to separate .txt files.

pdf-extractor-unit-test.title: Unit Test for PdfExtractor Text Extraction
pdf-extractor-unit-test.description: Demonstrates a simple console‑based unit test that extracts text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and verifies it against an expected string.

extract-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Text from PDF via Command Line
extract-text-from-pdf.description: Shows a simple command‑line tool that loads a PDF file, uses Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber to extract pure text, and writes the result to standard output.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.title: Extract PDF Text to StringBuilder and Save to File
extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from a PDF into a StringBuilder for manipulation before writing it to a text file.

extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.title: Extract PDF Text, Save to Temp File and Verify
extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, writing it to a temporary file, reading it back, and confirming the saved content matches the original extraction.

extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.title: Extract PDF Text and Encrypt with AES
extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.description: Demonstrates how to extract plain text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and then encrypt the resulting text file with AES (PBKDF2‑derived key).

check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.title: Detect Text‑Only PDF by Extracting Images
check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.description: Extracts all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and checks if any image files were created to determine whether the document is text‑only.

extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.title: Extract PDF Text and Store in PostgreSQL
extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.description: Demonstrates how to extract textual content from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and insert the extracted text into a PostgreSQL table for searchable indexing.

cancel-pdf-image-extraction.title: Cancel PDF Extraction with CancellationToken
cancel-pdf-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to use a CancellationToken to abort Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor operations such as text and image extraction when a user requests termination.

extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.title: Extract Text to MemoryStream and Merge with Generated PDF
extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.description: Demonstrates extracting text from a PDF into a MemoryStream, creating a new PDF from that text, adding a link annotation, and merging the original and generated PDFs.

extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.title: Extract PDF Text and Save as GZip Compressed File
extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and writing the result to a GZip-compressed file to reduce storage size.

report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.title: Report PDF Page, Image, and Attachment Counts
report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, count the total pages, images on each page, and embedded file attachments, then output the counts.

create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.title: Create PDF Summary from First Three Pages Text
create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.description: Demonstrates extracting text from the first three pages of a PDF using PdfExtractor (Facades) and generating a new PDF that contains the extracted text as a summary page.

retry-pdf-text-extraction.title: Retry PDF Text Extraction with PdfExtractor
retry-pdf-text-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor with a retry loop that handles IOException and attempts the operation up to three times.

extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.title: Extract PDF Text and Store in Azure Table
extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.description: Demonstrates how to extract all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and save the extracted content into an Azure Table entity with the document ID as the partition key.

async-pdf-text-image-extraction.title: Asynchronous PDF Text, Image, and Page Extraction
async-pdf-text-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text, images, and selected pages from a PDF file asynchronously using Aspose.Pdf, keeping UI threads responsive.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.title: Extract PDF Text to StringWriter for Logging
extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all text using TextAbsorber, and write the result into a StringWriter for integration with logging frameworks.

configurable-pdf-extraction.title: Configurable PDF Text, Image, and Attachment Extraction
configurable-pdf-extraction.description: Demonstrates reading a JSON configuration to toggle extraction of text, images, and embedded attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Facades and Document APIs.

extract-images-from-pages-png.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages
extract-images-from-pages-png.description: Demonstrates configuring PdfExtractor to extract only images from pages 5 through 10 of a PDF and saving each image as a PNG file.

extract-resource-images-pdf-extractor.title: Extract Images Defined in PDF Resources
extract-resource-images-pdf-extractor.description: Demonstrates how to set the ImageExtractionMode to retrieve images defined in PDF resources using reflection, then extracts the first image from a specified page.

extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.title: Extract Images from First PDF Page to Byte Arrays
extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull all images from the first page of a PDF and store each image directly in a byte array for further analysis.

extract-images-to-bmp.title: Extract PDF Images and Save as BMP
extract-images-to-bmp.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save each one as a BMP file while preserving the original resolution and color depth.

extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.title: Extract PDF Images to JPEG (Quality 85)
extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.description: The example demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save them as JPEG files with a compression quality of 85.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.title: Extract Images from PDF Using PdfExtractor
extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save them as PNG files in a temporary folder.

extract-images-to-base64.title: Extract Images from PDF and Convert to Base64 JSON
extract-images-to-base64.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, converting each image stream to a Base64 string, and serializing the collection into a JSON file.

extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.title: Extract Images from a Single PDF Page
extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to extract all images from a specific page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor by setting StartPage and EndPage to the same value.

extract-images-to-tiff.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as TIFF
extract-images-to-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull images from a PDF, set a high resolution, and write each image to a TIFF file for lossless archival storage.

extract-images-validate-signature.title: Extract and Validate Images from PDF
extract-images-validate-signature.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, then checking each file's header signature to ensure it is not corrupted and renaming it with the correct image extension.

parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.title: Parallel Extraction of Images from Multiple PDFs
parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to extract images from several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and Task.WhenAll for improved throughput.

extract-images-to-unc-share.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-to-unc-share.description: Shows how to load a PDF, enumerate images on each page using the ImageExtractor facade, and save the extracted images as PNG files to a UNC network path.

extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Thumbnails
extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts each embedded image, resizes it to a maximum of 200 pixels while preserving aspect ratio, and saves the result as PNG thumbnails.

extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.title: Extract Images from PDF Using PdfExtractor with Using Block
extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.description: Demonstrates how to use a using block to automatically dispose a PdfExtractor while extracting all images from a PDF and saving them as PNG files.

extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Images from Encrypted PDF Using Password
extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open an encrypted PDF by providing the user password and extract all embedded images using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

extract-text-only-ignore-images.title: Extract Text from PDF While Ignoring Images
extract-text-only-ignore-images.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract only the textual content from a PDF file while skipping any images by not invoking the image extraction method.

extract-images-to-html-report.title: Extract Images from PDF to HTML Report
extract-images-to-html-report.description: The example loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page to retrieve embedded images, converts them to base64 data URIs, and generates an HTML file that displays the images.

handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.title: Error Handling for PdfExtractor Bind Failure
handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.description: Demonstrates how to verify a PDF file exists, bind it with PdfExtractor, and catch PdfException when the file is corrupted.

extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Azure Blob Storage
extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts each embedded image using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and uploads the images as blobs to an Azure Blob Storage container.

extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.title: Extract PDF Images and Compress into ZIP
extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.description: Demonstrates extracting images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saving them as PNG files, and then creating a lossless ZIP archive of the extracted images.

extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.title: Extract Images in Original Format from PDF
extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF document while preserving their original format.

extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create CSV Manifest
extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.description: Demonstrates extracting images from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, saving them as PNG files, and generating a CSV manifest that records the file name, page number, and image dimensions.

extract-pdf-images-to-s3.title: Extract PDF Images and Upload to Amazon S3
extract-pdf-images-to-s3.description: The example opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's image resources, saves each image to a memory stream, and uploads it to an Amazon S3 bucket using the AWS TransferUtility.

extract-pdf-text-with-progress.title: Extract PDF Text with Console Progress Bar
extract-pdf-text-with-progress.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF file page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor while showing a console progress bar that reflects the extraction percentage.

extract-all-images-from-pdf.title: Extract All Images from PDF Using ImageExtractor
extract-all-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract images from every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.ImageExtractor by setting StartPage to 1 and EndPage to 0.

extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.title: Extract Images and Perform OCR on PDF Pages
extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each embedded image to a folder, and uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.OcrEngine (via reflection) to run OCR on the images, writing the recognized text to a results file.

list-embedded-attachment-names.title: List Embedded Attachment Names in PDF
list-embedded-attachment-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and enumerate the names of all embedded file attachments without saving them to disk.

extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.title: Extract Embedded Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enumerate embedded file attachments in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and write each attachment to a specified output directory.

extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.title: Extract and Rename PDF Attachments with Timestamp
extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its embedded files, and saves each attachment to disk with a unique timestamp and index prefixed to the original name.

extract-attachments-compute-sha256.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Compute SHA-256 Hashes
extract-attachments-compute-sha256.description: The example loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extracts all embedded file attachments to a folder, and then computes a SHA-256 hash for each saved file to verify its integrity.

extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Organize by File Extension
extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterates over its embedded files, and saves each attachment into a folder named after its file extension, handling duplicate names and missing content.

test-image-extraction-mode-pdf-extractor.title: Test ImageExtractionMode Influences Extracted Image Count
test-image-extraction-mode-pdf-extractor.description: Creates a PDF with two images and uses a unit test to verify that the default ImageExtractionMode extracts both images.

extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.title: Extract Images from PDF and Rename with GUID
extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save each image with a unique GUID‑based filename, preventing naming collisions.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create ZIP Archive
extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, extract each embedded image with Aspose.Pdf, and store the images in a ZIP file.

create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.title: Create Contact Sheet PDF from Extracted Images
create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.description: The example extracts all images from a source PDF using ImagePlacementAbsorber and then builds a new PDF that arranges those images as thumbnails in a grid, producing a contact‑sheet document.

extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create a PDF Portfolio
extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to extract all images from a PDF, save them as PNG files, and embed each image as an attachment in a new PDF portfolio document.

add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract PDF Images and Apply Watermark
add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor and then overlay a text watermark on each extracted image before saving.

extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as Base64 JSON
extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.description: Shows how to iterate through each page of a PDF, extract embedded images with PdfExtractor, convert them to Base64 strings, and write a JSON file containing image metadata.

extract-images-pdf-csv-index.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate CSV Report
extract-images-pdf-csv-index.description: The example opens a PDF, extracts each image on every page, saves the images to a folder, and creates a CSV file listing the image filenames, page numbers, and dimensions.

extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create a Sprite Sheet
extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and combine them into a single horizontal sprite sheet PNG.

extract-images-to-pdfa2b.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create PDF/A‑2b Document
extract-images-to-pdfa2b.description: The example extracts all images from an existing PDF, places them on a new page, and converts the result to a PDF/A‑2b compliant document.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and saving them to a network‑mapped UNC folder.

extract-images-html-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create HTML Gallery
extract-images-html-gallery.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF, save them as PNG files, and generate a simple HTML page that displays the images in a gallery.

extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.title: Extract PDF Images and Build Video Slideshow
extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.description: Shows how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor and then generate a video slideshow from the extracted JPEG files with FFmpeg.

extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Google Cloud Storage
extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and uploading each image to a Google Cloud Storage bucket with public read access.

extract-images-by-keyword.title: Extract Images from PDF Pages Containing a Keyword
extract-images-by-keyword.description: Shows how to scan each PDF page for a specific keyword using PdfExtractor and then extract images only from the pages where the keyword is found.

extract-images-markdown-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Markdown Gallery
extract-images-markdown-gallery.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to pull all images from a PDF, save them as PNG files, and generate a Markdown document that displays the images as a gallery.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.title: Extract Text from PDFs in a Docker-mounted Volume
extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates a .NET console service that scans a mounted directory for PDF files and uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract their text into .txt files.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs-azure-blob.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs in Azure Blob Storage
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs-azure-blob.description: A console app that iterates PDF blobs, downloads each to a temporary file, extracts all text using Aspose.Pdf, and uploads the .txt result back to the same container.

extract-images-pdf-to-word.title: Extract Images from PDF and Embed into Word Document
extract-images-pdf-to-word.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and embed them as image parts in a Word document with the Open XML SDK.

extract-pdf-images-to-sqlite.title: Extract PDF Images and Store as SQLite BLOBs
extract-pdf-images-to-sqlite.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF file and save each image as a BLOB in a SQLite database.

extract-pdf-images-to-s3-with-encryption.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to S3 with Server‑Side Encryption
extract-pdf-images-to-s3-with-encryption.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull all images from a PDF file and upload each image to an Amazon S3 bucket with AES‑256 server‑side encryption.
